audit: Read-only exact time direction, loss weighting and sampling facts
time_weight_formula: a_p(t)=1[finite(t) and 0<t<1] * max(t,eps)^(-p) / C_p, if normalize_time_weights=true; otherwise omit C_p
meaning: Larger time_power concentrates relative weight near CLEAN small t; it does not emphasize the high-noise endpoint.
normalize_time_weights divides by a fixed analytic E[max(U,eps)^(-p)] for U~Uniform(0,1). It is not per-batch weight normalization.
Unit mean of weights under uniform t does not imply identical loss/gradient magnitude because errors correlate with t.
normalize_time_weights remains a uniform-reference constant when time_sample_power changes; it does not normalize the new sampling density.

time_sampling.actual: t=U^alpha, U~Uniform(0,1) sampled per scene then indexed to agents
time_sampling.alpha_lt1: shifts sampling toward noisy high t
time_sampling.alpha_gt1: shifts sampling toward clean low t

interpretation: speed_p0 changes both inverse-time power1→0 and velocity coefficient4→2 relative to combo_reference, so its screen outcome cannot isolate power. high_noise changes source-time density and effective average weighted contributions, not only difficulty distribution.
